Description: On occasion, this delicate blade vibrates slightly when sheathed.
The grip of this massive sword tingles at your touch. While holding it, you can always feel a fresh breeze.
This simple staff hums quietly when grasped in both hands.
Hazak's clever alterations provide the hauberk's wearer with absolute freedom of movement.
This hammer has unrecognizable gristle caked on its head.
This chestpiece bears the markings of the Queen's Own Navy. It is lightweight enough that one could swim while wearing it.
This shield bears the markings of the Broadhead Marines. Its living wood can recover from splintering, if watered regularly.
This simple coat has a faintly sweet scent to it.
This filigreed bow feels damp to the touch.
This axe is coated in a sheen of sticky sap.
